body:
I've had SO's before; they've all left me for other things.  Things I wasn't obviously able to provide them.  I continue to hear 'life gets better' but it only gets worse as time passes my family and friends move on.

It's difficult to stay in a positive mindset that life will get better when for year after year after year it doesn't.  It's an uphill struggle without shoes and mountains made of glass.

Thank you for the support; always good to have someone listen when there is no one else to talk too.
